question: Which of the following is a traditional masked dance of West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gambhira.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• Gambhira is the traditional masked dance performed by the people of North Bengal.
 
• This dance is performed all over the Malda district of North Bengal during the festival of Chaitra Sankranti.
 
• This sacred devotional dance is performed by worshippers of Shakti.</li&
